title: WA National Guard Provides Aviation Support for Modrite Wildfire Response
credit: U.S. Air National Guard video by Master Sgt. Brandy Burke
description:
Washington National Guard Soldiers from the 1st Battalion, 168th General Support Aviation Battalion, support firefighting operations on the Modrite Fire in Ferry County, Washington. The Washington National Guard plays an active role in supporting the Washington State Department of Natural Resources with both aviation and ground firefighting support to safeguard lives and property in Washington state. (U.S. Air National Guard video by Master Sgt. Brandy Burke)
Footage includes UH-60 Blackhawk take off and water operations.
